'''August 2001 Tustin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Tustin, California in August 2001. [[Dan Lujan]] won it. It is known from Dunya Ertan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2828">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-12-tustin-ca-home-of-championship-prided2828/ tustin-ca-home-of-championship-pride], DeckTech (Dunya "Hardpack" Ertan, 12 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-12-tustin-ca-home-of-championship-prided2828/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' August 2001
* '''Site:''' Tustin, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 20
* '''Winner:''' [[Dan Lujan]]
